 1           Plaintiff Stream Trading Corp (“Plaintiff”) and Defendant Caleb McMeans (“Defendant,”

 2   and together with Plaintiff, the “Parties”), by and through their undersigned counsel of record,

 3   hereby stipulate and agree as follows pursuant to Civil Local Rules 6-1(a), 6-2(a), and 7-12:

 4           WHEREAS, on December 8, 2025, Plaintiff filed the Complaint (ECF No. 1);

 5           WHEREAS, on December 23, 2025, the Parties filed a Stipulation for Extension of Time

 6   to Respond to Complaint (ECF No. 18);

 7           WHEREAS, on January 27, 2026, the Parties filed a second Stipulation for Extension of

 8   Time to Respond to Complaint (ECF No. 20);

 9           WHEREAS, on February 25, 2026, the Parties filed a Stipulation for Extension of Time to

10   Respond to Complaint and to Continue Case Management Conference (ECF No. 28), which the

11   Court approved (ECF No. 29);

12           WHEREAS, on April 1, 2026, the Parties filed a Stipulation for Extension of Time to

13   Respond to Complaint and to Continue Case Management Conference (ECF No. 31), which the

14   Court approved, extending Defendant’s deadline to respond to the Complaint from April 10, 2026

15   to May 25, 2026 and continuing the Case Management Conference from April 21, 2026 at 2:00

16   p.m. to June 2, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. (ECF No. 32);

17           WHEREAS, on May 13, 2026, the Parties filed a Joint Motion to Stay (ECF No. 33), which

18   the Court granted that same day, staying the case pending resolution discussions and resetting the

19   Case Management Conference to September 22, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. (ECF No. 34);

20           WHEREAS, since the stay was granted, the Parties have committed considerable time and
21   resources working together to engage in a series of actions that will resolve all issues for the Parties,

22   including a possible restructuring of the affiliated entity that incurred the losses, and the Parties are

23   nearing a final resolution;

24           WHEREAS, the Parties request the Court continue the Case Management Conference

25   currently scheduled for September 22, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. to December 8, 2026 at 2:00 p.m., or to

26   such other date that is convenient for the Court, to allow the Parties additional time to finalize their
27   resolution;
